scopeAudit.colRootAudit: No exact COL26.8 usage node named Haptophyta exists in the complete pinned hierarchy. Therefore this release cannot derive a strict COL Haptophyta partition or infer one from name overlap.
scopeAudit.boundary: This ITIS-only sidecar retains every current species below the accepted ITIS Haptophyta division. It deliberately contains no COL match rows until a pinned COL release materializes an exact auditable Haptophyta root.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: Unavailable: COL26.8 has no exact Haptophyta root from which to derive a strict accepted-species partition.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: Unavailable: no COL Haptophyta partition exists in this release.
statuses.ambiguous: Unavailable: no COL Haptophyta partition exists in this release.
statuses.unmatched: Unavailable: no COL Haptophyta partition exists in this release.

matchingContract.prohibited: No inferred COL scope, fuzzy match, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered or taxon-substituted matching is used.

deliveryContract.pagesLight: Pages needs only this descriptor and may omit the ITIS-only row-level JSONL gzip shard.
deliveryContract.androidIosFull: Android and iOS complete-data inventories must include the descriptor and the listed ITIS-only shard as the same checksum-addressed bytes.
deliveryContract.runtimeChange: This import deliberately changes no formal runtime or published release manifest.

generatedBy.deterministic: Pinned input checksums, exact accepted-status SQL, explicit zero-COL-root audit, ascending TSN order and deterministic gzip; no wall-clock fields or fuzzy matching.
